subject: Request: HelioCore pilot - rate carveout & temporary discount approval
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliocore.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioCore pilot - proposed temporary rate carveout

Samir — great conversation this morning. Thanks again for walking me through the pilot objectives and the 6–8 week timeline. As discussed, HelioCore is asking for a temporary unit price ~35% below our published starter slab for the first three months to hit their internal pilot KPIs and get the engineering resources allocated.

I spoke with the customer success lead — they will commit to a 6-month post-pilot evaluation if the pilot hits the throughput/latency targets, and HelioCore is willing to make a small refundable commitment to reserve capacity. The ask is time-sensitive: they want an updated SOW and pricing this week to align with their procurement sprint.

Summary of the requested exception: 
- 35% discount off starter rate for pilot period (up to $40k/mo cap)
- Pilot term: 8 weeks (start date requested Aug 9)
- Limited to dev/staging environment; no production traffic
- Customer to sign mutual action plan and payment commitment (attached)

Attached: HelioCore_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), HelioCore_Pricing_Model.xlsx (modeling assumption), mutual_action_plan.docx

As this exceeds my commercial approval threshold, asking for your help to escalate for VP/CFO signoff. Key justification: strategic partner, strong go-to-market motion into two of our target clinical verticals, and potential for multi-region Dedicated upsell within 12 months.

Request: Can we get conditional signoff (VP/CFO) for a 3-month temporary carveout with the following guardrails:
1) Discount limited to pilot token volume not to exceed $120k total;
2) Explicit rollback to standard rates after pilot unless a committed expansion is executed;
3) Net-new clause (no stacking on existing credits).

Thanks — if helpful I can call now to walk through the numbers.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: HelioCore_SOW_v1.pdf, HelioCore_Pricing_Model.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCore pilot - proposed temporary rate carveout

Karthik — thanks for the summary. I reviewed the attached pricing model quickly. A few immediate concerns from a margin and precedent perspective: 

- 35% off starter rates is a meaningful delta; at scale this creates precedent for future renegotiations unless we hard-limit the scope.
- The $120k total ceiling helps but we need a clear definition of eligible usage (tokens vs API calls vs seats). Please ensure the SOW has a clear metric and cap.
- Refundable commitment is fine but we need billing terms (net 30) and an escrow/credit hold if they fail to convert.

I can support a conditional approval if we get the following: 
1) Explicit pilot usage definition in SOW (token-based with monthly cap)
2) Automatic reversion clause to standard pricing on day 91 unless expansion signature in place
3) Finance signoff on the refundable commitment instrument and collection method

Also cc'ing Marissa for revenue ops visibility and to ensure we have an appropriate GL/billing code to track this one-off. Marissa — if you can confirm we can enforce the cap and set a unique billing profile, I can route to VP/CFO for a quick sign-off memo.

-Laura
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCore pilot - proposed temporary rate carveout

Thanks Laura — agreed on the need for strict guardrails. Uploaded an updated SOW with specific usage language and a revised pricing tab that translates token volumes into an explicit monthly cap.

Quick clarifications: 
- Eligible usage = inference tokens billed via API key tied to the pilot project ID; model variants limited to the curated list in the SOW.
- If HelioCore exceeds the cap in any month, overage will be billed at standard starter slab (no discounted overage).
- Refundable commitment: $30,000 refundable credit held for the pilot; to be invoiced at start and released pro rata if conversion to paid contract occurs within 6 months.

Customer timeline: procurement needs docs by Monday (Aug 2) to complete internal approvals. They indicated a willingness to sign immediately upon receiving the SOW and clear billing terms.

I’ll prepare a one-page exec memo for routing — can you and Marissa sign off on wording and guardrails? If yes I’ll push this to VP/CFO for final approval.

—Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCore pilot - proposed temporary rate carveout

Karthik/Laura — reviewed the revised SOW and pricing workbook. Revenue ops can implement a separate billing code and enforcement mechanism for this pilot. I have two requests before I greenlight routing to VP/CFO: 

1) Limit the discount applicability to a single API key (project-specific) and include an explicit clause that discounts do not apply to any other accounts or linked projects.
2) Add a one-time administrative fee of $2,500 on top of the refundable commitment to offset setup/custom rules work. This keeps the unit economics less negative and sets a small barrier to misuse.

With those two changes, I recommend conditional approval and routing for VP/CFO signature with the following phrasing in the memo: 
"Approve HelioCore pilot discount (35% off starter slab) for up to 8 weeks, capped at $120k total, conditional on refundable commitment of $30k, admin fee $2,500, and automated reversion to standard pricing after 90 days unless expansion contract executed."

I can drop a quick note to revenue systems to provision the billing profile once the exec memo is signed.

—Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: VP-Finance <vp.finance@redwood.ai>, CFO <cfo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval requested — HelioCore pilot discount (time-sensitive)

VP / CFO — requesting expedited signoff on a conditional, time-limited discount for HelioCore (HelioCore Inc.) to enable a strategic pilot with a target large enterprise partner. Summary below. Full attachments and worksheets are included on the HubSpot record (link below).

Executive summary:
- Request: 35% discount off starter rates for a defined pilot period (max 8 weeks), capped at $120k total
- Guardrails agreed: token-based usage cap, discount applies to a single project API key, $30k refundable commitment invoiced at start, $2,500 administrative setup fee, automatic reversion to standard pricing after 90 days unless expansion contract executed
- Business rationale: pilot provides priority reference, expected Dedicated capacity upsell in 9–12 months; customer has cross-sell opportunities into two clinical lines we are prioritizing in H2

Attachments (in thread): HelioCore_SOW_v1.pdf; HelioCore_Pricing_Model.xlsx; mutual_action_plan.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/987654321

Timing: HelioCore procurement requests SOW by Monday (Aug 2) to meet their vendor board 8/6. We need a signoff today to deliver signed docs to the customer.

If you approve, suggested approval language: 
"Approved: temporary pilot rate carveout as described above, limited to the stated caps and conditional on the refundable commitment and admin fee. Finance to provision unique billing code; RevOps to enforce cap and automatic reversion."

Thanks for the quick review — I’m available to take a call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
